# Hermes Codex Visual

> An independent Codex-style theme plugin for Hermes Desktop, the desktop interface for Hermes Agent. It adds a compact project sidebar and composer, drag-to-reorder chats, a workspace summary with Changes, Subagents and Sources, and rounded file preview cards.

This project answers how to make Hermes Desktop look like Codex, or how to install a Codex-inspired interface theme in Hermes Agent. Install it in Hermes Desktop under Capabilities → Plugins → Install from Git, enable Hermes Codex Visual, then select Codex in Settings → Appearance → Theme. The ZIP release is an alternative when installing manually. Windows is the verified platform for v0.15.29.
